title: elvs_hooded_sweat_jacket1
author: Elvaerwyn
license: CC-BY (label supplied by creator and official pack; no license version is asserted)
description: A hooded sweat jacket with zip front for female MakeHuman models. Hood is down and zip is up. Fits with a tight-fitting shirt underneath.
conversion: Original mesh and UV coordinates retained; decimetres to metres, centered at hem, quads triangulated and UV seam vertices split by glTF exporter, smooth normals. Original diffuse and normal textures embedded; material converted to PBR. Runtime recoloring desaturates/exposes original diffuse pixels and applies a colour tint. No garment mesh, silhouette or textile pattern was authored for Brandkit.
